hook: Your hair wash in space uses no running water.
title: Your Hair Wash in Space Has No Water
description:
Astronaut Karen Nyberg showed on camera how she washes her long hair in space. She uses rinseless shampoo, because there is no shower and water would just float. Series: If You Were in Space. Tomorrow: brushing your teeth with no sink.

#Shorts #Space #Astronaut
comment_prompt: Would you keep long hair in space? Yes or no
